scope: Prototype iPhone app and Mac gateway for using lapis agents over Tailscale, with the phone joined beside the desktop so both stay in sync

hosts.mac: Apple Silicon, macOS 26.5, Xcode 26.6, iOS 26.5 Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro)

checks.name: gateway suite (scripts/tests/test_lapis_remote.py)
checks.result: 13/13 on macOS and on anvil: snapshot decoding with run columns and widths, history pages without a cursor, launch fingerprints equal to the pinned launch-spec values, registry reading, path-style places (~ and ssh host prefixes), admission rules, browser refusal, private phone captures; against a real session service: list, stream, paste and Enter, resize, another phone view taking over, release when the phone leaves, scrolling back through archived history from a joined view and following newer pages, a desktop-style client and the phone joined together with typing reaching both and the size following the device that typed, the phone surviving the desktop reattaching; and a stand-in pre-join service falling back to takeover

checks.name: iOS UI tests in a headless simulator (scripts/check_ios_remote.py --codex --claude)
checks.result: 9/9 with a Mac-side client attached the way the desktop is for the whole run: category cards with harness marks and a stopped agent; open, type, send and echo; key bar ^U; wide, emoji, right-to-left and box-drawing output; scrolling back loads history to a line from before 120 lines of output; Send screen to Mac saved a capture on the Mac; Settings connection check; another phone view taking the agent then Open here again; the phone and the Mac typing to each other on one agent; real Codex 0.155.1 and Claude Code 2.1.281 answering a prompt sent from the phone. Rows are drawn full height, so Codex's shaded prompt box shows no seams

checks.name: desktop with a joined view (workspace suite, real Workspace and LiveConnection)
checks.result: passes on macOS (three runs) and in the anvil gate: typing from the joined view reaches the desktop card, the desktop's typing reaches the view, the desktop stays ready, and the view survives Reconnect agent

checks.name: full desktop gate on anvil with joined views
checks.result: 56/56 (build, CTest suites, clang-tidy, format, cppcheck), again after joined views gained history paging

checks.name: desktop ASan on anvil
checks.result: 4/4: local-protocol, workspace (joined view against the instrumented service), live-connection, terminal-input

checks.name: gateway on this Mac's Tailscale address (LaunchAgent)
checks.result: health and agent list answered for the Mac itself; requests without X-Lapis-Client or with an Origin header refused; the simulator app listed the real workspace through the MagicDNS name over HTTP (ts.net transport exception)

checks.name: admission against the real tailnet
checks.result: of 64 peers, none admitted: the owner's two Linux machines, 26 devices of other users (one an iPhone) and 36 tagged devices; only the Mac itself is admitted until the owner's iPhone joins

checks.name: device build (scripts/install_ios_app.py --build-only)
checks.result: signed with the team's wildcard development profile, whose one device is the paired iPhone 17 Pro (Developer Mode on); not installed because the phone was not reachable

checks.name: on the phone
checks.result: installed on the iPhone 17 Pro at 11:01 pm MT September 23, updated at 12:15 am and 12:48 am September 24; after the phone joined the tailnet it listed the agents, opened one at 53 by 49 and sent input, all answered 200

limitations: Agents whose services started before joining existed (including the two running on September 24) are taken over by the phone instead of shared until they restart
Joined views do not page history, answer structured requests or end the agent
No push notifications, or restore without the desktop
Xcode's build service deadlocked on this Mac because kernel pipe memory was exhausted (new pipes held 512 bytes), so the app and tests are compiled directly with swiftc, actool and codesign
